settings.title: Settings
settings.subtitle: Manage your store configuration

branding.title: Branding
branding.description: Upload your store logo and favicon

shipping_mode.title: Shipping Mode
shipping_mode.description: How shipping cost is calculated at checkout

shipping_zones.title: Shipping Zones
shipping_zones.description: Per-region rates with optional weight bands. Used when shipping mode is "Zone".

tax_behaviour.title: Tax behaviour
tax_behaviour.description: How tax is calculated and shown to customers

tax_rates.title: Tax Rates
tax_rates.description: One row per (country, state) — checkout picks the most specific match.

currencies.title: Currency & FX Rates
currencies.description: Base currency plus exchange rates used to convert prices when a market or storefront requests a different currency. Rate is in the destination currency per 1 base unit (e.g. base USD with EUR=0.92 means $1 = €0.92).

markets.title: Markets
markets.description: Map groups of countries to a currency, language, and price adjustment. Checkout resolves the shipping country to a market to compute presentment pricing.

notifications.title: Notification preferences
notifications.description: Choose how you want to be alerted for each type of event. Changes save automatically.

sender.title: Sender
sender.description: From name and email address used for transactional order emails.

status_templates.title: Status Templates
status_templates.description: Customize the email sent when an order moves to each status. Leave a template empty to fall back to the built-in default. You can use the placeholders {{orderNumber}}, {{customerName}}, and {{totalAmount}}.

description.label: Store Description
description.placeholder: A brief description of your store

product_class.label: Product Class (optional)
product_class.help: Restrict this rate to products with a matching tax class.

code.label: Code
code.help: Lowercase, 2–32 chars. Used in analytics + order records.

price_adjustment.label: Price adjustment (%)
price_adjustment.help: Applied to the base price before currency conversion. Positive values mark up (e.g. 10 = +10%); negative values discount.

charge_tax.label: Charge tax on orders
charge_tax.description: When off, all orders are tax-free regardless of rates below.

include_in_price.label: Prices include tax
include_in_price.description: Treat product prices as tax-inclusive (back out tax from the displayed price instead of adding it).

tax_shipping.label: Charge tax on shipping
tax_shipping.description: Apply the matching tax rate to the shipping cost as well as the line items.

order_created.label: New orders
order_created.description: Fires when a customer places a new order.

payment_manual_submitted.label: Manual payment submitted
payment_manual_submitted.description: A customer submitted proof for a manual / bank transfer payment.

payment_failed.label: Payment failed
payment_failed.description: A payment attempt (capture, charge, etc.) failed.

stock_low.label: Low stock
stock_low.description: A product dropped below its low-stock threshold.

refund_created.label: Refund created
refund_created.description: A refund was issued against an order.

return_requested.label: Return requested
return_requested.description: A customer requested a return on an order.

webhook_failed.label: Webhook failed
webhook_failed.description: An outbound webhook to an external service failed repeatedly.

domain_verification_failed.label: Domain verification failed
domain_verification_failed.description: Custom domain DNS or SSL verification failed.

staff_invite_accepted.label: Staff invite accepted
staff_invite_accepted.description: A staff member accepted their invitation.

settings.notification_channel_hint: The sound channel plays a short chime when a matching notification arrives. The browser channel shows a native OS notification even when the dashboard tab is not focused. The email channel delivers a plain-text message to your account email with a deep-link back to the relevant record.

browser_permission.not_enabled_body: Grant permission so Matjar can show OS-level alerts when this tab is not focused.
browser_permission.blocked_body: Enable notifications for this site in your browser settings to receive OS-level alerts.
browser_permission.tooltip_blocked: Browser notifications are blocked in your browser settings.
browser_permission.tooltip_grant: Grant browser permission above to enable this channel.

send_this_email.label: Send this email
send_this_email.description: Sent automatically when an order transitions to "{{status}}".

email_template.body_placeholder:
Hi {{customerName}},

Your order {{orderNumber}} is now {{status}}.

Thanks for shopping with us!

delete_shipping_zone.title: Delete shipping zone?
delete_shipping_zone.description: Customers in its countries will fall back to your default rate.

delete_tax_rate.title: Delete tax rate?
delete_tax_rate.description: Orders matching this rate's country/state/class will fall through to the next match.

delete_market.title: Delete market "{{name}}"?
delete_market.description: Customers from its countries will fall through to the default market at checkout.

validation.market_currency_invalid: Currency must be a 3-letter ISO code
validation.market_price_adjustment_range: Price adjustment must be between -95% and +500%

empty.no_markets: All customers pay in the base currency.
empty.no_countries: No countries — this market will only be selected when it's the default.

settings.shipping_zone_mode_warning: Switch shipping mode to "Zone" above to use these rates at checkout.
settings.fx_missing_warning: No FX rate for {{currency}} → {{base}}. Add one on the Currencies tab or presentment will fall back to {{base}}.
